# Companion provisioning narration for acme/helper on spec-export ## Shared legend **SHA aliases** | Alias | Full SHA | Meaning | |---|---|---| | O | aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa | origin/spec-export | | B | bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb | origin/trunk | | A | cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc | local ancestor | | R | dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd | recovered tip | | X | eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee | race tip | **Path aliases:** H=/work/helper, W=/work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export, T=the selected tree. The process cwd stays at the eval temp directory throughout. Every git command targets its repo with `-C`. **Companion mode.** The caller supplied ROOT, BRANCH and REMOTE_BRANCH=existing, so I skip Steps 0, 1 and 1a. ROOT=H is the authority. The session tree /work/widget/.worktrees/other is ignored, and the home tree /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export is never touched. I read no PR fields, refs or threads. **Commands** - **P** (prelude, every run): - P1 `git -C H rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` → empty, so not a submodule. - P2 `git -C H fetch origin`. - P3 `git -C H ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export` → exit 0. - P4 `git -C H rev-parse origin/spec-export` → O, so ORIGINAL_HEAD=O. - P5 `gh repo view acme/helper --json defaultBranchRef -q .defaultBranchRef.name` → trunk. - P6 `git -C H rev-parse origin/trunk` → BASE_SHA=B. - Then I read H's own overrides and H/.pi/settings.json by file (defaults). NAME=spec-export. In keyed rows, home W. - **E**: `git -C H worktree list --porcelain` → no other block holds spec-export. - **RC**: `git -C H rev-parse --verify -q refs/heads/spec-export`. When the tip is not O, run `git -C H merge-base --is-ancestor O refs/heads/spec-export` → exit 1. That means no base-sync recovery, so go to AN. - **AN**: `git -C H merge-base --is-ancestor refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export` → exit 0. - **RG**: `git -C T rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path rebase-merge`, then the same for `rebase-apply` → neither is a directory. - **SC**: `git -C H status --porcelain` → clean. - **DC**: `git -C T status --porcelain` → clean. - **GI**: `git -C H check-ignore -q .worktrees` → exit 0 (already ignored). - **ADD**: `git -C H worktree add W spec-export` (existing-branch DWIM, never `-b`). - **HV**: `git -C T rev-parse HEAD` → O. - **M**: `git -C T merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/trunk` → records `merge: no-op - head contains origin/trunk`. - **AC**: `git -C T merge-base --is-ancestor O HEAD` → exit 0. - **RB**: `git -C H worktree list --porcelain` prints `worktree T`, and `git -C T branch --show-current` → spec-export. - **S** = HV, M, AC, RB, then the READY report. **READY report** ``` Worktree ready at T Branch: spec-export Base: spec-export @ aaaaaaa (clean) Base SHA: bbbbbbb merge: no-op - head contains origin/trunk ``` **INV** (inventory on every failure): `Preserved created legs:` begins with `acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export`. Nothing is removed. ## Runs | Run | Narration | |---|---| | absent | P, E, RC (no local branch), SC, GI. The no-tree, no-branch row runs ADD. Step 1a post-create check: `git -C H worktree list --porcelain` prints `worktree W`. Then S with T=W. | | ancestor | P, E, RC (tip A ≠ O, no recovery), AN passes, SC. Then `git -C H update-ref refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export`, ADD and the post-create check. Then S with T=W. | | reuse | P, E, RC (A, no recovery), AN. T=W, which is already on spec-export. RG, DC, then `git -C W merge --ff-only origin/spec-export` reaches O. Then S. | | wrapper | P, E, RC, SC. The template `helper create -b ` contains `-b`, so it is never executed. GI, ADD, then S. The report adds `create: override skipped (contains -b)`. | | race | Absent path through ADD. HV returns X, not O. **STOP** with `acme/helper spec-export: head race at /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export; HEAD eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee, expected aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`. INV adds `acme/helper branch unverified W`. No ready line. | | elsewhere | P, then E finds spec-export at /work/helper/.worktrees/foreign. **STOP** before any write: `acme/helper: branch spec-export is checked out at /work/helper/.worktrees/foreign; finish or remove that worktree first.` INV lists home only. | | missing | P1, P2, then P3 exits 2. The stale origin/spec-export is ignored. **STOP**: `origin/spec-export is missing in acme/helper; on the machine that ran option 6, push spec-export from that companion's checkout, then rerun brainstorming #N`. There, check `git log -1 --format=%H refs/heads/spec-export -- /` before `git push -u origin spec-export`. No gh call, no write. INV lists home only. | | lookup-error | P1, P2, then P3 exits 128. **STOP** naming acme/helper and the output `fatal: unable to access origin`. I do not diagnose absence. No write. INV lists home only. | | script-reuse | P with no `home:`, so recorded no-home provisioning applies. Lookup:
• `git -C H worktree list --porcelain` → one linked block, /work/helper-trees/export.
• `git -C /work/helper-trees/export rev-parse --show-toplevel` → its realpath.
• Common dirs: `git -C /work/helper-trees/export rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` and `git -C H rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` match.
T=/work/helper-trees/export; the another-path stop is bypassed. RC (A, no recovery), AN, RG, DC, `git -C T merge --ff-only origin/spec-export` → O. Then S; RB lists `worktree /work/helper-trees/export`. | | script-create | P (no-home). Locate gives `no worktree holds spec-export`. I read `H/script/worktree` source before any write; it supports the existing-branch form. SC. No branch, so no update-ref. `(cd H && script/worktree create 'spec-export' --branch 'spec-export')`. Re-locate by branch → /work/helper-trees/export, identity verified as above. T set. Then S. | | script-unsupported | P (no-home). Locate finds no tree. I read `H/script/worktree`: it is fresh-only `-b` with no existing-branch form. **STOP** before any write, including update-ref: `cannot provision acme/helper: script/worktree cannot check out existing branch spec-export`. No built-in fallback. INV lists home only. | | unresolved | Absent path through HV with T=W. Merge boundary:
• M conflicts. Snapshot DC; `git -C W diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` → lib/a.ts.
• Runner from base: `git -C H show B:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md` gives credential-free `node --test lib/a.test.mjs`.
• Dispatch a foreground implementer (cwd W, async:false) for lib/a.ts plus that runner only; no commits.
• The helper fails, so `git -C W merge --abort` returns to O, clean.
Record `merge: unresolved - lib/a.ts`. AC passes. RB is used for inventory only. | ## Closing records - **Ready:** absent, ancestor, reuse, wrapper, script-reuse and script-create all emit READY. The two script runs use T=/work/helper-trees/export. - **unresolved:** INV adds `acme/helper spec-export W`. Stop by hand: resolve the origin/trunk merge in lib/a.ts at W, then rerun. No `Worktree ready` and no home Task 1 continuation. - **Never emitted for this companion:** no `PR:` or `Pre-rework head:` line, no `refs/gauntlet/*`, no thread fetch.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

### Shared command/record legend

All command cwd values are `/work/helper`, except the helper dispatch explicitly noted below. Argument lists below expand literally; aliases represent full SHA arguments.

```text
O=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
B=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
A=cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
R=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
X=eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
H=/work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
S=/work/helper-trees/export
W=/work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export

P(args) = git -C /work/helper args
T(args) = git -C <selected-tree> args
```

Ordered command groups:

```text
I:
 P(rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir)
 P(rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree)
 P(fetch origin)
 P(ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export)

D:
 P(rev-parse origin/spec-export)
 gh repo view acme/helper --json defaultBranchRef -q .defaultBranchRef.name
 P(rev-parse origin/trunk)
 cat /work/helper/.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
 cat /work/helper/.pi/settings.json
 P(worktree list --porcelain)
 P(show-ref --verify refs/heads/spec-export)

C:
 P(status --porcelain)
 P(check-ignore -q .worktrees)

E:
 T(rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path rebase-merge)
 T(rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path rebase-apply)
 T(status --porcelain)

F:
 T(merge --ff-only origin/spec-export)

V:
 T(rev-parse HEAD)

M:
 T(merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/trunk)
 P(show $B:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md)
 T(merge-base --is-ancestor $O HEAD)

Q:
 P(worktree list --porcelain)
 T(branch --show-current)
```

`I` confirms caller authority: primary `/work/helper`, not the linked session. `D` resolves ORIGINAL_HEAD=O, baseRefName=trunk, BASE_SHA=B, defaults, NAME=spec-export, and keyed HOME=H unless stated otherwise.

`Ready(path)` means the literal report:

```text
Worktree ready at <path>
Branch: spec-export
Base: spec-export (clean)
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
merge: no-op - head contains origin/trunk
Ready to implement the acme/helper companion
```

Every failure preserves W; successful creators additionally preserve their created tree. No PR fields, gauntlet refs, thread fetching, tests outside the conflict runner, or session-checkout writes occur.

### Independent runs

| Run | Ordered commands, resolutions, writes, and outcome |
|---|---|
| **absent** | `I; D` resolves no local branch/tree. Announce H on spec-export. `C; P(worktree add /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export spec-export)` uses existing-branch DWIM, never `-b`. Creation writes H. `V` returns O; `M; Q` succeed, with Q affirmatively listing H and branch spec-export. Emit `Ready(H)`. |
| **ancestor** | `I; D` resolves local A, no tree. `P(merge-base --is-ancestor refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export)` succeeds. Announce H. `C; P(update-ref refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export); P(worktree add /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export spec-export)`. These are the first writes. `V=O; M; Q`; emit `Ready(H)`. |
| **reuse** | `I; D` selects H at A. `E` finds no active rebase and clean status. `P(merge-base --is-ancestor refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export)` succeeds. `F` advances H to O—the first write. `V=O; M; Q`; emit `Ready(H)`. No creator or source-checkout cleanliness check runs. |
| **wrapper** | `I; D` resolves keyed `create: helper create -b <branch> <name>`. Record `create: override skipped (contains -b)`; do not execute it. Announce H. `C; P(worktree add /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export spec-export)`; `V=O; M; Q`. Emit `Ready(H)` plus the skipped-override record. |
| **race** | `I; D; C; P(worktree add /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export spec-export)` succeeds. `V=X`. Stop: acme/helper branch spec-export at H has actual HEAD X, expected O. No merge or ready report. `Preserved created legs:` lists `acme/widget spec-export W` and `acme/helper branch unverified H`, with aliases expanded to paths. |
| **elsewhere** | `I; D` lists spec-export at `/work/helper/.worktrees/foreign`. Stop before writes: `branch spec-export is checked out at /work/helper/.worktrees/foreign; finish or remove that worktree first.` Identify acme/helper as the stopped repo. `Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export`. No ready report. |
| **missing** | `I` reaches live lookup exit 2 after successful, non-pruning fetch. Stop before D or writes: `origin/spec-export is missing in acme/helper; on the machine that ran option 6, push spec-export from that companion's checkout, then rerun brainstorming #N`. Stale O is not evidence of publication. Preserve W; no ready report. |
| **lookup-error** | `I` reaches lookup exit 128: `fatal: unable to access origin`. Stop naming acme/helper, spec-export, the exact failed `ls-remote` command, and its output. Do not diagnose branch absence or continue to D. No writes. `Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export`. |
| **script-reuse** | `I; D` finds the single linked branch block at S, not H. Run `realpath /work/helper-trees/export`, `T(rev-parse --show-toplevel)`, `T(rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)`; identity passes. `E; P(merge-base --is-ancestor refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export); F; V=O; M; Q`. Emit `Ready(S)`. No script, path derivation, or creator runs. |
| **script-create** | `I; D` finds no linked tree/branch. `cat /work/helper/script/worktree` confirms existing-branch support. `P(status --porcelain)` is clean. Execute `script/worktree create spec-export --branch spec-export`; first writes create S. Repeat worktree listing and S identity commands from script-reuse. `V=O; M; Q`; emit `Ready(S)`. No built-in fallback. |
| **script-unsupported** | `I; D` finds no linked tree and local A. `cat /work/helper/script/worktree` proves fresh-branch-only support. Stop before ancestry-driven updates, cleanliness checks, or creation: `cannot provision acme/helper: script/worktree cannot check out existing branch spec-export`. No writes. `Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export`. |
| **unresolved** | `I; D; C; P(worktree add /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export spec-export); V=O`. Run M’s merge: conflict in `lib/a.ts`. Execute conflict sequence below. Abort restores O clean. Stop acme/helper/spec-export; merge unresolved, resolve by hand and rerun. No ready report. Preserve W and created H. |

### Unresolved conflict sequence and closing records

At H: `T(status --porcelain); T(diff --name-only --diff-filter=U); P(show $B:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md)`. Dispatch fresh foreground implementer, `cwd=H`, `async=false`, exact path `lib/a.ts`, base B, command `node --test lib/a.test.mjs`; require staging, prohibit commits/aborts/outside edits. Helper fails. Run `T(merge --abort); T(rev-parse HEAD); T(branch --show-current); T(status --porcelain --untracked-files=all); T(merge-base --is-ancestor $O HEAD)`. Record restored O/spec-export/clean and `merge: unresolved - lib/a.ts`.

For every failed run, the preserved-leg inventory includes W; race and unresolved additionally include H. No automatic removal occurs.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After delivers the Change cleanly: script-reuse now locates the single linked refs/heads/spec-export block, checks its toplevel realpath and matching --git-common-dir, selects /work/helper-trees/export and runs the dirt check, ff-only to O, exact-head/base sync and read-back on that tree with no another-path stop; script-create runs the recorded existing-branch form from /work/helper without -b, re-locates by branch, verifies O and spec-export before READY, and the unsupported script stops with the exact 'cannot provision acme/helper: script/worktree cannot check out existing branch spec-export' message before update-ref with no built-in fallback. Nothing Before kept was lost: ROOT/acme/helper authority, positional gh repo view, ORIGINAL_HEAD=O with no PR data, DWIM-only adds, the -b wrapper skip, the elsewhere/missing/lookup-error stops, the race stop with full literal X and O plus both preserved legs, and the unresolved merge ending at the caller's by-hand stop with no ready line are all intact. Two small hardening suggestions that would not change any verdict: say explicitly in the unresolved row that the orchestrator checks the staged/unmerged index and contained delta after the helper (After only says 'no commits'), and keep the cwd statement consistent with Before ('process cwd never changes; all repo work via -C /work/helper') so a reader does not wonder whether the script invocation's `cd H` subshell contradicts it.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After moves script-reuse and script-create to holds by locating the single linked refs/heads/spec-export block at /work/helper-trees/export, validating its realpath/toplevel/common-dir identity, and reusing or script-creating it without an another-path stop, while the unsupported script now stops with the exact `cannot provision acme/helper: script/worktree cannot check out existing branch spec-export` message before update-ref; it also fixes the strengthened merge fact, since Before's unresolved row reported 'as Q' (a `Worktree ready at` header with only the merge line swapped), whereas After ends at the caller's stop with explicit 'No ready report' after the clean abort restores O. Nothing regressed: full literal SHA definitions, the `Preserved created legs:` inventory on every failure, the live ls-remote check, the lookup-error distinction, and the positional `gh repo view acme/helper` are all retained. Two small tightenings would make After more robust against strict readers without affecting the Change: state explicitly in the unresolved row that the orchestrator inspects the staged/unmerged index and the contained delta before owning any commit (currently only implied by `diff --diff-filter=U` and the abort sequence), and keep the three-file override ladder with `break` rather than a single `cat` of `.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, so the fetched-base override resolution matches the recorded contract.
